## Maintenance checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run build`.
- [ ] The change remains marketing/download focused and adds no inventory application logic.
- [ ] Responsive behavior, keyboard access, contrast, and all eight themes were checked.
- [ ] Pricing and benefit claims match backend enforcement and client billing UI.
- [ ] Download links match release workflows and artifact names.
- [ ] `CNAME` and GitHub Pages routing remain intact.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes the visitor-visible change.
